notes: Identity verified from title, authors, and DOI in supplied text: Sweet Future: Fluctuating Blood Glucose Levels Affect Future Discounting, X.T. Wang and Robert D. Dvorak, 10.1177/0956797609358096. Full primary six-page OnlineFirst research report plus publisher cover; pagination 1–6 differs from final 183–188. No PDF supplied. Locator p.4 can mean PDF page 4 (printed p.3) or printed p.4. Candidate tests: condition-by-time discounting ANCOVA F(1, 59) = 15.61, partial eta squared .21, prep > .999; sugar pre/post t(31) = 2.55, Cohen’s d = 0.45, prep > .95; aspartame pre/post t(32) = 3.12, Cohen’s d = 0.54, prep > .99. Printed p.4 Fig.2 shows a T2 blood glucose to T2 discounting path labelled −.23; significant paths have prep > .95; coefficient standardization is not established in supplied text. No candidate is assigned to target. Separate blood-glucose ANCOVA partial eta squared 0.56 tests glucose, not discounting. Printed prep values are replication probabilities, not conventional p; no conversion performed. Methods count 65 and condition counts 32 and 33 remain participant-count candidates only. No analytic N inferred from df or recruitment totals and no final-group sum asserted. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders.
